rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=20, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, epochs=48, unet_c=16, lr=0.0005, rationale=iter-7 (toward 20): epochs 32->48 at the NEW lr=5e-4 PEAK (lr 1e-3->5e-4 just lifted ep32 0.9501->0.9532). The old ep64-overfit verdict was at the coarser lr=1e-3 where each step moved further; at the halved lr, ep32 is likely UNDER-converged. Re-probe epochs at the new lr. Hyp: if ep48>0.9532 the new-lr ep32 peak was under-convergence (optimization-limited, keep climbing epochs); if flat/lower, the ~0.953 band is the STRUCTURAL half-view info-loss ceiling and epochs are exhausted -> pivot lever next iter.
